digest.component_or_area: LLM gateway observability and request correlation
propositions: Operators cannot correlate anonymous LLM calls through an OpenAI-compatible gateway to rebar gate runs or observability backends because rebar sends no request metadata or trace identifiers.
The trace_id field is declared in review_result and completion_verdict schemas but hardcoded to None in runner.py, leaving the correlation identity unimplemented.
Header values must support interpolation of environment variables and per-run context (trace_id, ticket_id, operation) to enable dynamic correlation without committing credentials to config files.
Resolved headers carrying sensitive values must be redacted from all logs, diagnostics, and serialized verdict records to prevent accidental credential exposure.

Headers with forbidden names (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) or control characters (CR, LF, NUL) must be rejected at config resolution to prevent security and protocol injection attacks.
